events.title: Shapur I is crowned co-ruler of the Sasanian Empire
events.description: Ardashir I, founder of the Sasanian Empire, had named Shapur his successor in a council of the magnates, and Shapur was crowned co-ruler with him. He may have been crowned again as sole ruler in 243, but Richard N. Frye thinks a single coronation more likely.
events.html: Ardashir I, founder of the Sasanian Empire, had named Shapur his successor in a council of the magnates, and Shapur was crowned co-ruler with him. He may have been crowned again as sole ruler in 243, but Richard N. Frye thinks a single coronation more likely.

events.title: Anthemius is proclaimed Western Roman emperor
events.description: Backed by the eastern emperor Leo I, Anthemius was raised to the western throne near Rome. A joint expedition against the Vandals failed, and he was killed in 472.
events.html: Backed by the eastern emperor Leo I, Anthemius was raised to the western throne near Rome. A joint expedition against the Vandals failed, and he was killed in 472.

events.title: King Edwin of Northumbria is baptised by Paulinus
events.description: Edwin, king of Deira and Bernicia, was baptised with his chief men by Paulinus, the first Bishop of York, according to Bede. He was the first ruler of both kingdoms to convert to Christianity.
events.html: Edwin, king of Deira and Bernicia, was baptised with his chief men by Paulinus, the first Bishop of York, according to Bede. He was the first ruler of both kingdoms to convert to Christianity.

events.title: Emperor Manuel I Komnenos enters Antioch in triumph
events.description: Having received the submission of Raynald of Châtillon, Prince of Antioch, the Byzantine emperor Manuel I Komnenos rode through Antioch in a grand ceremonial procession. The prince and the King of Jerusalem followed him on foot.
events.html: Having received the submission of Raynald of Châtillon, Prince of Antioch, the Byzantine emperor Manuel I Komnenos rode through Antioch in a grand ceremonial procession. The prince and the King of Jerusalem followed him on foot.

events.title: Fourth Crusade storms Constantinople
events.description: Crusaders and Venetians broke into Constantinople and began three days of pillage. They set up a Latin Empire, and Byzantium never recovered its former strength.
events.html: Crusaders and Venetians broke into Constantinople and began three days of pillage. They set up a Latin Empire, and Byzantium never recovered its former strength.

events.title: First Union Flag is adopted for English and Scottish ships
events.description: A royal proclamation of James I ordered ships of England and Scotland to fly a new flag combining the crosses of St George and St Andrew. St Patrick's saltire was added in 1801.
events.html: A royal proclamation of James I ordered ships of England and Scotland to fly a new flag combining the crosses of St George and St Andrew. St Patrick's saltire was added in 1801.

events.title: Confederate guns open fire on Fort Sumter
events.description: Confederate batteries bombarded the federal fort in Charleston harbour, forcing its surrender the next day. The attack began the American Civil War.
events.html: Confederate batteries bombarded the federal fort in Charleston harbour, forcing its surrender the next day. The attack began the American Civil War.

events.title: Union raiders seize the locomotive General in the Andrews Raid
events.description: Union volunteers led by the civilian scout James J. Andrews commandeered the locomotive The General at Big Shanty, Georgia, and took it north toward Chattanooga, damaging the Western and Atlantic Railroad. Confederate forces chased them for 87 miles.
events.html: Union volunteers led by the civilian scout James J. Andrews commandeered the locomotive The General at Big Shanty, Georgia, and took it north toward Chattanooga, damaging the Western and Atlantic Railroad. Confederate forces chased them for 87 miles.

events.title: Franklin D. Roosevelt dies at Warm Springs
events.description: Franklin D. Roosevelt died of a cerebral haemorrhage in Georgia early in his fourth term. Harry Truman became president and presided over the end of the war in Europe and the Pacific.
events.html: Franklin D. Roosevelt died of a cerebral haemorrhage in Georgia early in his fourth term. Harry Truman became president and presided over the end of the war in Europe and the Pacific.

events.title: Salk's polio vaccine is declared safe and effective
events.description: Results of a nationwide trial involving more than a million children showed Jonas Salk's vaccine worked. Mass vaccination soon cut polio cases dramatically.
events.html: Results of a nationwide trial involving more than a million children showed Jonas Salk's vaccine worked. Mass vaccination soon cut polio cases dramatically.

events.title: Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human in space
events.description: Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin orbited the Earth once aboard Vostok 1 in a flight of 108 minutes. The achievement gave the Soviet Union a major lead in the space race.
events.html: Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin orbited the Earth once aboard Vostok 1 in a flight of 108 minutes. The achievement gave the Soviet Union a major lead in the space race.

song: Patriots of Buenos Aires in the wars of independence; later the Argentine Republic
A song written in Buenos Aires in 1813, during the fight for independence from Spain, that became Argentina's national anthem.
